_schema: Drift from stock, one entry per model, all measured by the same method (see 'method'). models.<key>: null while the run is pending; {"reference": true} for stock; otherwise {"kld": mean KL divergence, "kld_pm": its ± from llama-perplexity, "top1": same-top-token %, "ppl": mean perplexity on the slice (optional), "q8_sha256": first 16 hex of the Q8_0 file measured (optional, to catch picking the wrong file)}. Keys: stock, prime, v1, v2, v21, v3. collect_v3.py turns these into drift.kld_<key> / drift.ppl_<key>; a null entry renders as 'run in progress' while drift.kld_<key> is listed in values.json meta.in_progress.
method: llama-perplexity --kl-divergence on a fixed wikitext-2 test slice (context 512, 40 chunks), each model's Q8_0 GGUF against the official stock Q8_0
